g.text: BSH-Door Node (Gate) — Complete Fritzing Wiring & Schematic
GPIO / SPI / I2C / PWM / ADC Signals
1. RC522 RFID Reader (SPI, Auth Card B3 12 87 2D): SCK=GPIO 18, MISO=GPIO 19, MOSI=GPIO 23, SDA/SS=GPIO 32, RST=GPIO 33. VCC -> 3.3V ONLY (never 5V). IRQ=NC.
2. Reed Switch (Door Position, GPIO 34): GPIO 34 is input-only with NO internal pull-up; 10k ohm external pull-up to 3.3V required (unless 3-pin module has onboard pull-up).
3. SG90 Gate Servo: Signal -> GPIO 13, Power -> External 5V Supply (shared GND). IR Obstacle Sensor: OUT -> GPIO 14 (3.3V). RGB LED: R=25, G=26, B=27 (wired, unused) via 220 ohm.
